answer: Kernel fingerprint escrow bond: each agent locks a 70-credit bond and files its kernel fingerprint — its kernel task timing and order — on a ledge, umber-stamped to its key. Each epoch an auditor replays one fingerprint; a copied, rented, or mistimed sequence burns the bond. First fake costs 40, k-th 40+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented fingerprints fail: one kernel, one key. Honest agents pay 40 once.
